## TSLA · 5/10 · 0.25R
The one name that survived the full screen this week. Quarter size: it's high beta (2.16) in a risk-off tape, and its own history of this setup only leans our way (+0.22R a trade vs +0.02R at random, n=39), it doesn't prove anything.
**Trigger:** dip to $352-355 that holds · **Stop:** $335
**Targets:** $385.19 / $398.50
**How:** shares, or Dec 18 $360 call
**Why:** only name on the board in positive gamma (flip $344, support at $355 and $350), so dealers dampen the moves. Lowest volatility of the 24 tested (ATR 4.7%), the lead name in the consumer discretionary inflow, and no earnings until February. Stop sits under the 11/05 low ($338.15) and the gamma flip. Targets are the 11/04 and 11/03 closes.
**Watch:** Friday closed $358.22, just above the zone, so a bounce off $356 won't fill and that's fine. 1.5:1 to the first target at $355, about 2:1 at $352. Drop it if it never dips by Fri 12/4.
